parameters.query: INSERT INTO "Product" (name, slug, description, price, "precioBase", images, stock, "categoryId", subcategory, grupo, tipo_producto, published, featured, "createdAt", "updatedAt", proveedor, ref_proveedor, ref_variante, ean, marca, categoria_texto, categoria_padre, color, talla, activo, visible_web, sku_interno) VALUES ('{{ String($json.name ?? "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '{{ String($json.slug ?? "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '{{ String($json.description ?? "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', ROUND(({{ Number($json.precioBase ?? 0) }}::numeric * CASE WHEN {{ Number($json.precioBase ?? 0) }} < 50 THEN 1.50 WHEN {{ Number($json.precioBase ?? 0) }} < 100 THEN 1.47 WHEN {{ Number($json.precioBase ?? 0) }} < 200 THEN 1.43 WHEN {{ Number($json.precioBase ?? 0) }} < 400 THEN 1.38 ELSE 1.30 END * 1.21), 2), {{ Number($json.precioBase ?? 0) }}, {{ Array.isArray($json.imagenes) && $json.imagenes.length > 0 ? "ARRAY[" + $json.imagenes.map(img => "'" + String(img).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'").join(",") + "]::text[]" : "ARRAY[]::text[]" }}, {{ Number($json.stock ?? 0) }}, '{{ String($json.categoryId ?? "sin-clasificar") }}', '{{ String($json.subcategory ?? "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', {{ $json.grupo ? "'" + String($json.grupo).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : "NULL" }}, {{ $json.tipo_producto ? "'" + String($json.tipo_producto).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : "NULL" }}, {{ Boolean($json.published ?? true) }}, false, NOW(), NOW(), '{{ String($json.proveedor ?? "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '{{ String($json.ref_proveedor ?? "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', NULL, {{ $json.ean ? "'" + String($json.ean).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : "NULL" }}, '{{ String($json.marca ?? "Miniland").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, {{ Boolean($json.activo ?? true) }}, {{ Boolean($json.visible_web ?? false) }}, '{{ String($json.sku_interno ?? "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}') ON CONFLICT (sku_interno) DO UPDATE SET "categoryId" = EXCLUDED."categoryId", subcategory = EXCLUDED.subcategory, grupo = EXCLUDED.grupo, tipo_producto = EXCLUDED.tipo_producto, name = EXCLUDED.name, slug = EXCLUDED.slug, description = EXCLUDED.description, price = ROUND((EXCLUDED."precioBase" * CASE WHEN EXCLUDED."precioBase" < 50 THEN 1.50 WHEN EXCLUDED."precioBase" < 100 THEN 1.47 WHEN EXCLUDED."precioBase" < 200 THEN 1.43 WHEN EXCLUDED."precioBase" < 400 THEN 1.38 ELSE 1.30 END * 1.21)::numeric, 2), "precioBase" = EXCLUDED."precioBase", images = EXCLUDED.images, stock = EXCLUDED.stock, ean = EXCLUDED.ean, marca = EXCLUDED.marca, published = EXCLUDED.published, activo = EXCLUDED.activo, visible_web = EXCLUDED.visible_web, "updatedAt" = NOW() RETURNING id;
